title: KHost plugin catalog
description: Every published release of every plugin a KHost host can offer on its Plugins > Available tab. The host's own model and tools/validate.py are the authority; keep this in step with both.

schemaVersion.description: The document format. A host that does not know the value rejects the whole file.

id.description: The plugin manifest's id; how a host matches a listing to an installed plugin.

repository.description: Where the source lives, so a host can look before installing unsandboxed code.

capabilities.description: What the publisher says the plugin provides, for the browse list.

releases.description: Every release ever published; never remove one so older hosts keep an installable build.

version.description: The plugin's own version: up to four dot-separated numbers.

apiVersion.description: The KHost plugin API this build was built against. A host installs it when its MinimumVersion <= apiVersion <= CurrentVersion.

url.description: An https download of the release zip, fetchable without credentials.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the zip, computed from an anonymous download by KHost's CatalogSync. Never typed by hand.

rid.description: The platform a build only runs on; absent for one that runs anywhere.
